description_en: Clones an existing security report. The new security report has the same configuration as the existing security report
description_zh: 云安全中心系统配置，安全报告，克隆报表功能，克隆后将新增一个和此配置相同的报告
name: CopyCustomizeReportConfig

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
指定请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认值为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the report.

You can call the [DescribeCustomizeReportList](~~DescribeCustomizeReportList~~) operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh:
报告ID。

调用[DescribeCustomizeReportList](~~DescribeCustomizeReportList~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: report_id
